title: Family Trust Distribution Tax (Primary Liability) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase family trust distribution tax to reflect the higher Medicare levy proposed in the wider package of DisabilityCare Australia tax amendments.
It would raise the rate from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent for the income or capital amounts subject to this tax.
The timing rules would distinguish certain Commissioner notices from other cases, with the new rate generally covering distributions and entitlements from 1 July 2014.
changes: The primary liability rate for family trust distribution tax would increase to 47 per cent.
For liabilities triggered by specified Commissioner notices, the change would apply to notices issued on or after 1 July 2014.
Other liabilities would use the new rate for distributions made or present entitlements conferred on or after 1 July 2014.
summary.affected: People liable for family trust distribution tax on income or capital are affected.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
